items.title: Dave Brubeck — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'Richard Rogers' as an example of a Broadway composer to play, but the interviewee (Dave Brubeck) does not respond with any personal anecdote, relationship, or specific interaction regarding Richard Rogers.

ctx.x: That’s a good question, because I remember somebody would say something like, you should start playing show tunes of some of the most well-known Broadway shows and just do a whole series of those. So we did Cole Porter and . . .
. . . Richard Rogers. Then my favorite is . . .
